name: Blockhead Bot
description: Adds Blockhead Bot to the Vehicle Spawn brick's list. It strolls around its brick, walks round and over builds to get where it is going, and in its builder's mini-game arms itself and fights: it turns its aim like a person, keeps the distance its weapon wants, turns on whoever hurts it and searches where it last saw you. Bots of the same builder are on one side. Outside mini-games it is harmless.
